scope: Proposition 8.1 of the manuscript “One-sided negative sectional curvature and the holomorphic Liouville property” (preprints/One-sided-negative-sectional-curvature-and-the-holomorphic-Liouville-property-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 359 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dedbbd2f24f8281c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For some fixed finite integer n, there is a smooth strictly plurisubharmonic potential ℓ on Cn ×C whose Kähler metric is complete and has nonpositive real sectional curvature. The potential satisfies every hypothesis of Proposition 3.5, for a countable dense set of centers in the unit disk and every spatial Taylor order. Thus all bounded holomorphic functions on its half-plane tube are constant.
